main_businesses.title: Things I've Built
main_businesses.description: The projects that took more than a weekend. Tools, templates, and data experiments I built because I needed them and kept improving them.

items.title: GoFork
items.description: I kept making the same repo-selling setup over and over. So I turned it into a starter that handles the boring parts for me and for anyone else building something similar.

items.title: DataBookShop
items.description: I got tired of doing manual research. So I started scraping, collecting, and organizing useful data into neat little books that are easier to browse and actually use.

items.title: Charted Data
items.description: A simple starter for turning raw Markdown into something more interactive. I wanted blog posts that feel less like text dumps and more like stories with structure.

items.title: GitData
items.description: I started collecting interesting GitHub projects and organizing them into a machine-readable dataset. It became a way to keep track of what is new, useful, and worth looking at.

marketplace_businesses.title: Little Shops
marketplace_businesses.description: Small digital experiments. A few products, a few experiments, and a lot of trying to see what feels useful enough to sell.

items.title: Online Dollar Store
items.description: I wanted to see how far a simple $1 store could go. It turned into a fun test of pricing, product decisions, and how people respond to a very low-friction offer.

items.title: Render Assets
items.description: I kept making 3D assets and wanted a place to put them without letting them sit in folders forever. So I built a tiny shop around that.

items.title: ResourceBunk
items.description: A place for practical digital files for people building with actual tools—print, CNC, design, production. Useful stuff, not just filler.

free_projects.title: Stuff I Made Free
free_projects.description: Things I built and decided to leave open for everyone. No paywall, no gatekeeping—just useful stuff I wanted to share.

items.title: GPUIKit
items.description: I kept making visual assets for projects and finally decided to put all of them in one place. It became a huge little library of things I had been collecting anyway.

items.title: designmd.lol
items.description: A small library of design instructions for AI coding agents. I wanted to make prompts and design rules easier to reuse, so I put them out there with no cost.

community_businesses.title: Building Together
community_businesses.description: Experiments around people, participation, and building things in public. A little messy, a little fun, and meant to be shared.

items.title: Launch Here Lol
items.description: A platform for makers to launch projects, solve small challenges, and keep momentum going. It grew out of the idea that building is better when people can see it and join in.
